title: Revenue Recognition
summary: Legacy revenue recognition Topic, largely superseded by ASC 606 for virtually all transactions; retained as a historical placeholder in the Codification.
description: ASC 605 governed revenue recognition before the 2014 joint FASB/IASB project replaced it with ASC 606. It consists of industry-specific guidance that has been superseded for essentially all transactions.

bannerNotice.title: Superseded
bannerNotice.body: ASC 606 now governs virtually all revenue recognition; ASC 605 retains almost no independent substantive content.
